title: SPIKE DASH
oneLiner: Leap across tiny platforms, grab every coin, and dodge the spikes before the screen gets frantic.
mechanics: Auto-run across one-screen platforms and steer left or right in midair.
Press A to jump; collect coins for points.
Touching spikes or falling off the platforms costs a life.
Platforms shift and spikes multiply as time passes.
lose: Lose when all three lives are gone after hitting spikes or falling.
scoring: Each coin collected scores 100 points, with a bonus for collecting several in a row.
